question: Vishal, Ajay, Ketan, Sachet and Raunak are sitting in a straight row facing the same direction. Vishal is sitting immediate to the left of Ketan. Sachet is not sitting next to Ajay. Raunak sits second to the right of Vishal. Ajay sits third to the left of Raunak. Who is sitting immediate to the left of Sachet?
solution: **Five person: **Vishal, Ajay, Ketan, Sachet and Raunak 1) Ajay sits third to the left of Raunak. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1011155e162b1c85852d6f2286b1925b6e660d90f4f9c4f1ca9a53a09f682269.png]
